name: sceneview-mcp
description: SceneView 3D & AR SDK reference — API docs, samples, code validation and generation.
long_description: Serves the SceneView SDK's own reference to any MCP-compatible assistant: node signatures and defaults, platform setup for Android, Apple, Web, Flutter and React Native, complete compilable samples, migration guides, and a validator that checks generated Kotlin or Swift against the real public API before it reaches the reader.
